name: pricing
description: Pricing. Sets the price from what they pay today. Takes the money already leaving their account for this problem, works out the year, and gives three prices with what each one leaves them, or checks a price you already have in mind, with the working shown so it can be argued with. Then puts the chosen price on the deal. Use when the user says "what should I charge", "pricing", "how much is this worth", "set the price", "founding price", "am I charging too little", or before writing an offer.
